title: GameWorld: Standardized Platform for Multimodal AI Agent Evaluation
summary: A comprehensive platform and benchmark for evaluating multimodal AI agents across 34 browser-based games. It provides a state-verifiable sandbox with ground-truth state access to test spatial navigation and long-horizon planning.
research_notes: Includes a specialized browser sandbox that pauses game time during model inference; currently used as a primary benchmark for embodied digital agents.

evolution.summary: Evolved from the 'Gameworld 10k' research benchmark by VERSES AI into a community-driven platform under the gameworld-project organization in April 2026, expanding from 10 to 34 games.
